# Resourceful Living

> > Australian manufacturer transforming plastic waste into sustainable building materials and office furniture through circular economy innovation.

Based in Newcastle NSW, Resourceful Living operates a Buy-Back Product Program that converts HDPE and LDPE plastic waste into recycled plastic panels and products. The company serves the Australian construction and commercial sectors with sustainable alternatives that meet Green Star and NABERS requirements.

## Key Topics

- Recycled plastic panels
- Circular economy
- Buy-Back Product Program
- HDPE and LDPE recycling
- Sustainable building materials
- Australian-made products
- Green Star certification
- NABERS compliance
- Waste reduction
- Social procurement
- Office furniture
- Plastic recycling manufacturing
- Newcastle NSW operations
- ESG compliance
- Chemical recycling innovations
